notes.title: Dev Diary #1 | Development Progress and Roadmap
notes.content:
Dev Diary #1The Future of Lemegeton


Bearers of the Mark,

We at WildPlan are here once again to share the current progress of Lemegeton and our plans for the future.





Refining Combat
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615082/479ee4045c5cd43dd2700ad8b8a348ff020d1b80.png"]The core of Lemegeton lies in the tension and weight of 1-vs-Many combat. We are currently focusing on balancing and enhancing the feel of battle to deliver a more satisfying experience. Our goal is to ensure that every moment of being surrounded by enemies feels impactful and strategic.





Upcoming Combat Demo Test
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615082/1e2005de5483b1e478307209c91b011380c2a6b1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615082/fa2a86994c60d8f559e9336331f406950741bbb6.png"]

We are planning to release a Combat Demo in a closed format soon. 

Through Steam's Closed Beta feature

Or by recruiting participants separately via our Discord.


Roadmap
Late August ~ Early September 2025: Closed Combat Demo release

End of 2025: Public playable demo release

Early 2026: Early Access release with feedback applied

 It will take a little more time, but we believe this process is essential to deliver a truly polished experience.    




World and Additional Content

Beyond combat, the true heart of Lemegeton lies in its worldbuilding. We will gradually reveal the secrets of this world, the characters, and the places it holds. Stay tuned as we share more lore and development records through official news updates.



    
Closing Words
 Thank you for waiting and for your continued support. Your voices are our greatest strength.  We will keep sharing development news and worldbuilding updates. Lemegeton, a roguelike action game about "Overcoming and Hope."
